text: Added A-001. Needs more information. Understood so far: a supplier delay. Please tell me which shipment is late (or which part, to which plant), the date it was originally due, and the new arrival date. No operational records were changed. The tower escalated the report and wrote nothing else.

Added A-002. The message reports a supplier delay of 20-inch alloy wheel (WHEEL-20) from Helix Power (SUP-09) into Wacky Wheels Huntsville (P_AL) from 2027-03-15 until 2027-03-22 on shipment SH-0045. Affected records: 5 production orders and 50 customer orders. The tower completed 5 reschedules, 26 dealer notices, and 15 loaner assignments.
